WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif., Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —[Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RSxjYy9wkg8CWdy3nk9DoD6KTss4ZI5mwxQCnCDStYSHGo9usP7Rspl1T9GY4CP_Zq_zY0RNZ4ZsJigYgWit4xkSsKmyct-xhBjTjBigNoU=) (Nasdaq: ARQT), a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing meaningful innovations in immuno-dermatology, today announced that Arcutis management will present at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference, taking place September 14-16, 2026, in New York.


Details for the Company’s participation are as follows:


**Fireside Chat:** Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 1:50 p.m. ET


The webcast for this conference may be accessed via the “[Events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0BLTLKC7B1bFdavS1zBD4JhFT3PWeOSjj6so781hxb0qezVBlhzpI1ckoQQkbIiEYAcuBDWx9Tdpx6sWYeKPMPLOUoT7nVgozstMNWGtXY3DCZreJv25UBlD32MGjqs0CFaWnq1P-7rWMkuzhR5jTg==) ” section of the Company’s website. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Arcutis website for 180 days following the conference.


**About Arcutis**


Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARQT) is a commercial-stage medical dermatology company delivering meaningful innovation to address the needs of individuals living with chronic inflammatory skin diseases. Over the past decade, Arcutis has successfully developed a robust portfolio of advanced targeted topicals approved to treat three major inflammatory skin diseases, driven by a commitment to solving the most persistent patient challenges in dermatology. Arcutis’ unique dermatology development platform, built on established scientific pathways and coupled with deep clinical dermatology and commercial expertise, enables us to efficiently develop, scale, and deliver our differentiated therapies while advancing a growing pipeline across a range of inflammatory dermatological conditions.
